features: 65W Super Fast Charging Power Bank – High-output 65W USB Type-C PD power bank delivers ultra-fast charging for laptops, tablets, and smartphones, making it ideal for work, travel, and daily use.
20000mAh High-Capacity – Large 20000mAh battery paired with 65W max power delivery ensures extended backup and reliable high-speed charging for power-hungry devices.
Type-C PD Input & Output Port – Dual-purpose Type-C PD port supports 65W output and fast input, allowing the power bank itself to recharge quickly while supporting fast device charging.
Built-In Type-C Braided Cable – Integrated flat-braided Type-C cable supports up to 65W charging, doubles as a lanyard, and eliminates the need to carry extra cables.
Smart LED Display for Charging Status – Advanced LED digital display shows real-time battery percentage and charging status, so you always know when you’re using 65W fast charge.
Compatible with Laptops, Tablets & Smartphones – Designed to support 65W laptop charging, along with smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other Type-C PD-enabled devices.
Compact & Travel-Ready Power Bank – Powerful 65W output in a compact, lightweight design, perfect for professionals, travelers, and heavy users who need fast charging on the go.
